items.question: What fasting duration is proclaimed for Shaiva practitioners?
items.inference: Shaiva practitioners observe a three-night fast.
items.plain_english: For Shaivas, a three-night fast is proclaimed.

items.question: What preliminary-rite fasting duration applies to Shakta practitioners?
items.inference: Shakta practitioners observe a first-night fast with preliminary rite.
items.plain_english: For Shaktas, a first-night fast with preliminary rite applies.

items.question: What fasting duration is proclaimed in lunar and self-born contexts?
items.inference: A two-night fast is proclaimed for those contexts.
items.plain_english: In lunar and self-born contexts, a two-night fast is proclaimed.

items.question: What should the goddess hear about the fruit of tradition?
premises: The fruit of tradition is spoken
items.inference: The goddess is told to hear the briefly spoken fruit of tradition.
items.plain_english: Thus, in brief, the fruit of tradition is spoken; hear it.

items.question: What effect is attributed to the three spoken traditions?
items.inference: The three traditions cause all accomplishments.
items.plain_english: The three traditions are spoken as causing all accomplishments.

rows.grounds: compound lord of Kadi Hadi mata

items.question: What qualities define the lord of Kadi and Hadi mata?
premises: He is free from desire faults
He is lord of Kadi Hadi mata
items.inference: The lord of Kadi and Hadi mata is free from desire and related faults.
items.plain_english: Free from desire and related faults, he is lord of Kadi and Hadi mata.

items.question: What sovereignty is said to arise in the world?
premises: It is like an unsurpassed jewel
items.inference: All sovereignty arises in the world like an unsurpassed jewel.
items.plain_english: All sovereignty becomes his in the world, like an unsurpassed jewel.

rows.grounds: long compound with vidya rays great mantra mandala

items.question: What mantra-mandala equipment is attributed to the practitioner?
premises: He is united with vidya rays
He is united with great mantra
He is united with mantra mandala
items.inference: The practitioner is equipped with vidya-ray great mantra and mantra mandala.
items.plain_english: He is united with the great mantra of vidya rays and the mantra mandala.

items.question: What recitation and eightfold equipment is attributed to the practitioner?
premises: He is declared with eight eights
He is endowed with five recitations
items.inference: The practitioner has eight-eights equipment and five recitations.
items.plain_english: He is declared with eight eights and endowed with five recitations.

items.question: What sandhya and recitation practice is attributed to the practitioner?
premises: He is united with four sandhyas
He is endowed with five recitations
items.inference: The practitioner performs four sandhyas and five recitations.
items.plain_english: He is united with four sandhyas and endowed with five recitations.

items.question: What great vidya and footstool equipment is attributed to the practitioner?
premises: He is united with great vidya
He is endowed with ten footstools
items.inference: The practitioner has great vidya and ten footstools.
items.plain_english: He is united with great vidya and endowed with ten footstools.

items.question: Whose life-mind bursting and movement is described?
premises: The relative refers to a practitioner
items.inference: The practitioner's life-mind undergoes bursting and movement.
items.plain_english: Whose life and mind undergo bursting and movement, O goddess.

items.question: Who is proclaimed as lord of sixty accomplishments in Kerala?
premises: A lord of sixty accomplishments is named
items.inference: The Kerala practitioner is proclaimed lord of sixty accomplishments.
items.plain_english: He who is Kerala is proclaimed lord of sixty accomplishments.

rows.grounds: compound endowed with Vama etc qualities

items.question: What moral and Vama qualities are attributed to the practitioner?
premises: He is free from meanness etc
He is endowed with Vama etc qualities
items.inference: The practitioner is free from meanness and endowed with Vama qualities.
items.plain_english: Free from meanness and endowed with Vama and related qualities.

rows.grounds: compound lord of twenty-four accomplished ones

items.question: Who is called lord of twenty-four accomplished ones and best of men?
premises: He is lord of twenty-four accomplished ones
items.inference: The practitioner is lord of twenty-four accomplished ones and best of men.
items.plain_english: He is lord of twenty-four accomplished ones and best of men.

rows.grounds: compound with both upper and lower traditions

items.question: What tradition affiliation is said for great Kashmir?
premises: He is united with both upper and lower traditions
items.inference: Great Kashmir is said to be united with both upper and lower traditions.
items.plain_english: United with both upper and lower traditions, great Kashmir is said.

items.question: What divine conversation and destructive power are attributed to the practitioner?
premises: He is conversant with divine hosts
items.inference: The practitioner converses with divine hosts and destroys Garuda and related powers.
items.plain_english: Conversant with divine hosts and destroyer of Garuda and related powers.

items.question: What heroic, devotional, and sensory qualities are attributed to the practitioner?
items.inference: The practitioner is a world-bliss hero, devotee of women, and conqueror of senses.
uncertainties: Doctrinal nuance of devotee of women unspecified
items.plain_english: A hero making world bliss, devotee of women, and conqueror of senses.

items.question: What qualification is said to be possessed before and here also?
premises: It was before and here also
items.inference: The stated qualification is possessed both before and here, O Parvati.
items.plain_english: Possessed of the stated qualification, before and here also, O Parvati.

items.question: What strength and zeal characterize the one called Gauda?
items.inference: The one called Gauda has great strength and great zeal.
items.plain_english: Great strength and great zeal characterize the one called Gauda.

items.question: What accomplishment-giving role is assigned to Gauda?
items.inference: Gauda is spoken of as giver of all accomplishments.
items.plain_english: Thus Gauda is spoken of as giver of all accomplishments.

items.question: What alternative was spoken before in the three traditions?
items.inference: An alternative was spoken before within the three traditions.
items.plain_english: In the three traditions, O goddess, an alternative was spoken before.

items.question: What renouncer, enjoyer, humble, and worshipper traits are listed?
premises: Humble and daily tithi worshipper are named
items.inference: The practitioner is renouncer, enjoyer, humble, and daily tithi worshipper.
items.plain_english: Renouncer, enjoyer, humble, and daily tithi worshipper.

items.question: What prohibited acceptance of another's wife and wealth is listed?
items.inference: Acceptance of another's wife and wealth is listed as the sixth prohibited item.
items.plain_english: Another's wife, another's wealth, and acceptance as the sixth.
